import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot of price vs. megapixels, colored by sensor_type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df, 
    x='megapixels', 
    y='price_usd', 
    hue='sensor_type', 
    palette='muted', 
    style='has_video_4k', 
    markers={0: "o", 1: "X"},
    alpha=0.7
)

# Set axis labels and title
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)

# Adjust legend
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video', title_fontsize='13', loc='upper left', fontsize='11')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
